title: Warby Parker bets on Google AI glasses for growth, but privacy fears still loom
summary: Warby Parker is entering the smart glasses market in partnership with Google and Samsung, betting that demand for the artificial intelligence wearables will balloon in the coming years.
llm_summary: Warby Parker is teaming up with Google and Samsung to launch its own line of AI‑powered smart glasses, betting that demand for wearable artificial‑intelligence devices will surge in the next few years.
